summary.content:
Today's selection covers 57 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 34 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Samsung is adding Perplexity to Galaxy AI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: PayPal Data Breach Led to Fraudulent Transactions
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from SecurityWeek, The Verge, TechCrunch, BBC Technology, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 16 articles published in the last 24 hours
